info.description: Multi-tenant REST API for white-label mobile apps. Every JSON response uses the `{success, data, meta}` / `{success:false, error, meta}` envelope. Send `X-Client-Id` on every request; authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

The body is required (Content-Type: application/json). Afterwards the old access and refresh tokens are rejected, and the email can register again.

XRequestId.description: Request correlation id (echo of the request header, or generated by the server).

XClientId.description: Tenant slug. Required in shared-mode deployments for operations without a bearer token (the token carries the tenant otherwise; when both are sent they must match). Optional in dedicated deployments, where the tenant is fixed. Android apps should always send it.
